card: Enables -Wmissing-prototypes and -Wmissing-declarations compiler flags in CMake and addresses the resulting warnings across 177 files. The PR gives internal linkage to translation-unit-local functions, prunes dead header declarations, and ensures definitions match header prototypes. Commit notes show the missing enforcement previously allowed prototypes to diverge unchecked. The PR is a draft RFC requiring upstream subtree changes and depends on #36813.
changed_since_previous: Rebased onto #36813 instead of #36744, added placeholder `[nomerge]` changes for minisketch, and expanded warning cleanups to 177 files.
evidence: Commit b9cff75536 notes that 'ForceActivation' was declared locally in 'guiutil.cpp', so the definition was never checked against the declaration
Author notes in PR description: 'Draft for now, as it requires upstream changes, and some codebase/style decisions. Some of the fixes will be split off in advance.'
problem: Functions intended to be private to a single translation unit default to external linkage, cluttering symbol tables and hiding dead code. Furthermore, without compiler enforcement, function definitions can silently diverge from their intended header prototypes or be defined without including the header that declares them.

risk.why: A mistake in linkage or header declarations could cause compilation failures on some platforms or break symbols expected by tests.

scope_notes: Very large RFC containing over 170 files and placeholder `[nomerge]` commits modifying external subtrees (LevelDB, crc32c, minisketch) that need upstreaming. Many commits are mechanical refactorings making functions `static` or reorganizing forward declarations.
summary: Enables `-Wmissing-prototypes` (Clang) and `-Wmissing-declarations` (GCC) compiler warning flags in CMake and resolves all triggered warnings across the codebase. Across roughly 177 files, it assigns internal linkage (`static`) to translation-unit-local functions, removes unused declarations from headers, adds missing declarations to proper headers, and includes temporary placeholder patches for subtrees.
